subject: Physics
prompt: Moment of inertia of solid sphere about diameter?
explain: Standard result: solid sphere about diameter I = 2MR²/5.

subject: Physics
prompt: Moment of inertia of thin ring about its axis?
explain: All mass at distance R, so I = MR² for a ring about its own axis.

subject: Physics
prompt: Moment of inertia of disc about its central axis?
explain: Disc about central axis perpendicular to plane: I = MR²/2.

subject: Physics
prompt: Parallel axis theorem: I about parallel axis?
explain: Parallel axis theorem adds Md² to the CM moment of inertia.

subject: Physics
prompt: Perpendicular axis theorem applies to which bodies?
explain: Iz = Ix + Iy holds only for planar (flat) laminas lying in xy-plane.

subject: Physics
prompt: Torque in vector form?
explain: Torque τ = r × F; order matters — it's not F × r.

subject: Physics
prompt: Angular momentum L of a particle?
explain: L = r × p is the definition; for rigid body L = Iω along same axis.

subject: Physics
prompt: Condition for conservation of angular momentum?
explain: dL/dt = τ_net; if τ_net = 0, angular momentum is conserved.

subject: Physics
prompt: Rotational KE of a rigid body?
explain: Rotational KE = (1/2)Iω², analogous to (1/2)mv² in translation.

subject: Physics
prompt: For pure rolling, relation between v and ω?
explain: No slipping ⟹ contact point velocity = 0, giving v_cm = Rω.

subject: Physics
prompt: Total KE of a body rolling without slipping?
explain: Rolling KE = translational KE + rotational KE = ½mv² + ½Iω².

subject: Physics
prompt: Radius of gyration K is defined as?
explain: K = √(I/M); it's the RMS distance of mass from the rotation axis.

subject: Physics
prompt: Newton's 2nd law for rotation?
explain: Rotational analogue of F = ma is τ_net = Iα.

subject: Physics
prompt: Work done by torque through angle θ?
explain: Analogous to W = F·d, rotational work W = τθ (for constant τ).

subject: Physics
prompt: Power delivered by a torque?
explain: P = dW/dt = τ·dθ/dt = τω, analogous to P = Fv.

subject: Physics
prompt: MI of thin rod about one end (perpendicular axis)?
explain: Rod about one end: I = ML²/3; about centre: I = ML²/12.

subject: Physics
prompt: MI of thin rod about its centre (perpendicular axis)?
explain: Rod about centre: I = ML²/12, which is Icm used in parallel axis theorem.

subject: Physics
prompt: A solid sphere rolls down incline; fraction of KE that is rotational?
explain: For solid sphere I=2mR²/5; rotational fraction = (2/5)/(1+2/5) = 2/7.

subject: Physics
prompt: For a disc rolling without slipping, rotational KE fraction?
explain: Disc I = mR²/2; fraction = (1/2)/(1+1/2) = 1/3.

subject: Physics
prompt: Acceleration of CM of body rolling down incline (angle θ)?
explain: Rolling down incline: a_cm = g sinθ / (1 + K²/R²) where K² = I/m.

subject: Physics
prompt: Angular impulse equals?
explain: Angular impulse = τ·Δt = ΔL, analogous to linear impulse = FΔt = Δp.

subject: Physics
prompt: MI of hollow sphere (shell) about diameter?
explain: Hollow spherical shell about diameter: I = 2MR²/3 (greater than solid sphere).

subject: Physics
prompt: Torque on a body is zero. Which quantity is conserved?
explain: τ = dL/dt; τ = 0 ⟹ L = constant (angular momentum conserved).

subject: Physics
prompt: Instantaneous axis of rotation for pure rolling passes through?
explain: In pure rolling the contact point has zero velocity; it's the instantaneous axis.

subject: Physics
prompt: Speed of topmost point of a purely rolling body (v_cm = v)?
explain: Top point velocity = v_cm + Rω = v + v = 2v in pure rolling.

subject: Physics
prompt: MI of solid cylinder about its central (symmetry) axis?
explain: Solid cylinder about its own axis: I = ½MR², same as disc.

subject: Physics
prompt: MI of hollow cylinder (thin-walled) about its symmetry axis?
explain: All mass at radius R, so I = MR², same as thin ring.

subject: Physics
prompt: MI of solid cylinder about an axis through its centre, perpendicular to symmetry axis?
explain: For solid cylinder: I = M(R²/4 + L²/12) about transverse central axis.

subject: Physics
prompt: Perpendicular axis theorem: Iz = Ix + Iy. Which axis is z?
options: Axis in the plane along width
Axis in the plane along length
explain: z is the axis perpendicular to the lamina's plane; x and y lie in the plane.

subject: Physics
prompt: MI of disc about a diameter (in-plane axis through centre)?
explain: By perpendicular axis theorem: I_diameter = (MR²/2)/2 = MR²/4.

subject: Physics
prompt: MI of thin ring about a diameter?
explain: Perpendicular axis: I_axis = MR²; each diameter I = MR²/2 by symmetry.

subject: Physics
prompt: Relation between angular momentum L and torque τ?
explain: Torque equals rate of change of angular momentum, analogous to F = dp/dt.

subject: Physics
prompt: A dancer pulls arms in; moment of inertia decreases. Angular velocity?
explain: No external torque ⇒ L = Iω = const; I↓ ⇒ ω↑.

subject: Physics
prompt: For a rigid body, L = Iω holds when ω is measured about?
options: The same axis used for I
explain: L = Iω is valid only when both I and ω refer to the same axis.

subject: Physics
prompt: Rolling without slipping condition for acceleration: a_cm and α?
explain: Differentiating v = Rω with respect to time gives a_cm = Rα.

subject: Physics
prompt: Friction acts on a rolling body on a rough incline. Nature of friction?
explain: No slipping means contact point has zero relative velocity; friction is static.

subject: Physics
prompt: For hollow sphere rolling without slipping, rotational KE fraction of total KE?
explain: Hollow sphere I = 2MR²/3; KE_rot/(KE_rot+KE_trans) = (2/3)/[(2/3)+1] = 2/5.

subject: Physics
prompt: Speed of CM when hollow sphere rolls down height h from rest?
explain: Energy: Mgh = ½Mv²(1+2/3) = 5Mv²/6, so v = √(6gh/5).

subject: Physics
prompt: Speed of CM when solid cylinder rolls down height h from rest?
explain: Mgh = ½Mv²(1+½) = 3Mv²/4, giving v = √(4gh/3).

subject: Physics
prompt: Which body reaches bottom of incline first when all roll without slipping?
explain: Smaller I/MR² (= 2/5 for solid sphere) gives largest acceleration down incline.

subject: Physics
prompt: Dimensional formula of moment of inertia?
explain: I = MR² has dimensions of mass × length², i.e., [ML²].

subject: Physics
prompt: SI unit of angular momentum?
explain: L = Iω → kg·m²·s⁻¹, equivalently J·s.

subject: Physics
prompt: Torque τ and angular momentum L are related as τ = dL/dt. If τ=0 and L≠0, body?
explain: Zero torque ⇒ L = const ⇒ Iω = const; for rigid body I is fixed, so ω is constant.

subject: Physics
prompt: Moment of inertia of rectangular plate (sides a, b) about axis through centre, perpendicular to plate?
explain: I_x = Mb²/12, I_y = Ma²/12; by perp. axis thm I_z = M(a²+b²)/12.

subject: Physics
prompt: For pure rolling on a surface, the contact point has what velocity?
explain: Rolling without slipping: contact point is instantaneous rest; velocity = 0.

subject: Physics
prompt: Velocity of centre of mass of a body rolling with ω on a surface (radius R)?
explain: Pure rolling condition: v_cm = Rω (no slipping at contact).

subject: Physics
prompt: For rotational equilibrium of a rigid body, net torque about any point must be?
explain: Rotational equilibrium requires Στ = 0 (no angular acceleration).

subject: Physics
prompt: Analogue of mass in rotational motion is?
explain: I plays role of mass in τ = Iα, just as F = ma in linear motion.

subject: Physics
prompt: For a system, angular momentum about CM + angular momentum of CM about origin equals?
explain: L_total = r_cm×Mv_cm + I_cm·ω; spin + orbital = total angular momentum.

subject: Physics
prompt: If radius of gyration of a disc about its axis is K, then K equals?
explain: I = MK² = MR²/2 ⇒ K = R/√2 for disc about central axis.
